concept.title: HVAC components
concept.shortdesc: Components include services, folders and other model building blocks associated with a module. You may drag them to a property or wire sheet from a palette. These components provide various control functions used in commercial HVAC applications.

conbody.p:
The descriptions included in the following topics appear as headings in documentation. They also appear as context-sensitive help topics when accessed by:
Right-clicking on the object and selecting ViewsGuide Help
Clicking HelpGuide On Target
